author: Original procedural geometry created for Meridian Noir
generator: Three.js, scripts/scene.js; headless Microsoft Edge via Playwright
artDirection: Ultra-premium matte-black mechanical chronograph, subtle metallic edges, soft blue accents, deep black studio background, soft rim lighting, controlled metal reflections, luxury engineering aesthetic. No text, no labels, no logos on renders.
motion: Smoothly transition from the assembled watch to an exploded view; components gently separate in alignment in 3D space.

outputs.frames/*.webp: 101 rendered frames, 0..100, encoded by ffmpeg libwebp quality 83

font.name: Manrope
font.license: SIL Open Font License, included as fonts/OFL.txt

technicalLimitations: Stylized mechanical study, not a functional watchmaking blueprint.
